# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jan 7, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing the Optimism protocol with interop migration support, improving test coverage for core contracts, and integrating supernode trace providers into op-challenger.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Protocol Enhancements & Interoperability
- **Interop Migration Support:** Implemented interop migration functionality within OPCMv2, a crucial step for cross-chain interoperability within the Superchain ecosystem. ([#18649](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18649))

### Improved Test Coverage and Stability
- **OptimismMintableERC20 Contract Testing:** Significantly improved test coverage for `OptimismMintableERC20` by converting focused tests to fuzz tests and adding new tests for previously uncovered code paths. ([#18696](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18696))
- **OptimismMintableERC20Factory Test Coverage:** Enhanced test coverage and standardized naming conventions for `OptimismMintableERC20Factory` by renaming existing fuzz tests and improving overall test quality. ([#18707](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18707))

### Infrastructure and Tooling Updates
- **Supernode Trace Provider Integration:** Integrated the supernode trace provider into `op-challenger`, setting the stage for replacing `op-supervisor` support with a more streamlined configuration. ([#18668](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18668))
- **Op-Batcher Nil Pointer Dereference Fix:** Addressed a critical bug in `op-batcher` that caused a nil pointer dereference and process crashes when `forcePublish` was true and `currentChannel` was nil. ([#18701](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18701))
- **Op-Supernode Environment Variable Fix:** Corrected an issue in `op-supernode` related to environment variable prefix handling, ensuring proper configuration of `OP_SUPERNODE` variables. ([#18720](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18720))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Dependency Updates:** A pull request to update `urllib3` from 1.26.19 to 2.6.3 in `/ops/check-changed`. ([#18730](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18730))
- **Interop Activity & Chain Container Interfaces:** New PRs related to `op-supervisor` interop activity and updating chain container interfaces in `op-supernode`. ([#18728](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18728), [#18727](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18727))
- **Testing Improvements:** Several new pull requests focus on testing, including removing a stale TODO comment in a cannon provider test, adding additional tests for `DeployImplementations` and `opchain`, and introducing EL `eth_simulate` and flashblock acceptance tests. ([#18726](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18726), [#18725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18725), [#18724](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18724), [#18723](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18723))

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
- **Super Dispute Games at Genesis:** A new issue has been opened to support the use of super dispute games at genesis. ([#18729](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18729))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### OPCM Rollup Config Fields
- **Issue:** OPCM version 0.0.11 does not generate Pectra rollup config fields, specifically missing `chain_op_config` fields like `eip1559Elasticity`, `eip1559Denominator`, and `eip1559DenominatorCanyon`. ([#14816](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/14816))
- **Latest Discussion:** DeborahOlaboye expressed interest in working on this issue and requested assignment.

### Flaky Acceptance Tests
- **Issue:** Re-enabling flaky acceptance tests that were previously skipped. ([#16972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16972))
- **Latest Discussion:** DeborahOlaboye volunteered to work on this issue and requested assignment.

### Supernode Reporting and Consistency
- **Issue:** `op-supernode` currently reports the minimum L1 block processed by derivation, not necessarily by verifiers. This needs to be updated to reflect the minimum L1 block verified. ([#18651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18651))
- **Latest Discussion:** pauldowman noted that this issue depends on interop support in `supernode`.
- **Issue:** Ensuring consistency in `superroot_atTimestamp` responses in `op-supernode` to prevent inconsistencies due to race conditions. ([#18667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18667))
- **Latest Discussion:** pauldowman indicated that this also depends on interop support in `supernode`.

### Challenger VM Runner Update
- **Issue:** Updating the `op-challenger` vm-runner to utilize `supernode` instead of `supervisor`, with no need for backward compatibility. This will likely require a `syncStatus` API. ([#18669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18669))
- **Latest Discussion:** pauldowman confirmed the dependency on a `syncStatus` API from `supernode`.

### Kona Acceptance Test Support
- **Issue:** The `TestSequencerPreset` in `kona|acceptance-tests` does not support the kona sequencer, leading to issues when running monorepo acceptance tests targeting `kona-node`. ([#18675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18675))
- **Latest Discussion:** crStiv expressed interest in attempting to resolve this issue.
